summary: Himax Technologies, Inc., a Taiwan-based semiconductor company, filed a Form 6-K on August 6, 2026, attaching a press release reporting Q2 2026 financial results and providing Q3 2026 guidance. The release details Q2 revenues of $227.4 million (up 14.2% sequentially, exceeding guidance), gross margin of 33.1%, after-tax profit of $19.9 million (11.4 cents per diluted ADS), and Q3 guidance for revenue growth of 7% to 11% QoQ and gross margin around 34%. The filing is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation. There are no M&A, activist, restructuring, or capital return elements. The registrant is simply filing its periodic results and forward-looking statements.
